messages:
Aisha Rahman: picking up escalation from BetaML. They get a 400 with "dimension mismatch: expected 1536 got 768" when calling embeddings after upgrading SDK. Ticket ref: BETA-1082. Posting their minimal repro and notes below.

Aisha Rahman: Customer repro (python sdk):
```
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key="REDACTED")
resp = client.embeddings.create(model="rwd-embed-1", input=["x","y"], batch_size=32)
print(len(resp.data[0]))  # -> 768 for them
```
Response: 400 {"error":"dimension mismatch: expected 1536 got 768"} but when they run curl it returns 1536.

Tomás Rivera: thanks Aisha. quick sanity checks: 1) confirm model dims (rwd-embed-1 should be 1536), 2) ask for trace id + full headers, 3) ask them to run direct REST curl to rule out server/regression.

Aisha Rahman: trace id they gave: trace_2026-03-14_9bd2. They also included UI screenshot showing they upgraded from redwood-sdk 0.11.4 -> 0.13.0 at the same time.

Priya Nair: jumping in. Two likely causes in my experience: 1) SDK mapping altered default model alias so "rwd-embed-1" points to a lite variant client-side, 2) client introduced a downsample/compact path that returns 768-d embeddings for performance in some codepaths.

Sara Gomez: I repro locally: pip install redwood-sdk==0.13.0, run same snippet. I get 768 dims back. Curl direct to /v1/embeddings with model="rwd-embed-1@stable" returned 1536. So SDK/aliasing is the culprit.

eng-sdks-bot: opened ENG-SDK-1147: incorrect model-dimension mapping in v0.13. Marked P0.

Tomás Rivera: immediate support runbook proposal for agents handling these errors: 
1) Request trace id + raw request headers + body.
2) Ask customer to run the curl REST snippet pinned to version (e.g., rwd-embed-1@stable) to confirm server output.
3) If curl -> expected dim and SDK -> wrong dim: advise downgrade to 0.11.4 or install hotfix 0.13.1 when available.
4) Temporary header workaround: set `X-RWD-Disable-Embed-Downsample: 1` on requests to force full-dim server path (server currently honors this header).
5) If customer sees p95 latency regressions when batch_size > 8, recommend batch_size <= 8 and file perf ticket; note that runtime batching scheduler changed in last canary rollout.
6) Escalate to ENG-SDK immediately with logs/traces if SDK misbehaves.

Aisha Rahman: customer ran curl after our ask; they confirmed curl returns 1536. They also said they tried pinning model to rwd-embed-1@stable but still got 768 using sdk 0.13.0.

Priya Nair: confirms SDK is converting alias to a lite variant internally. Mitigation: publish SDK patch to re-lock alias mapping and add a stricter client check to warn when client receives mismatch for pinned model. Eng-sdks to push hotfix.

infra-bot: deploy-log: embeddings-runtime v2.15 deployed to canary 2026-02-27 21:40 UTC; new batching scheduler enabled. No rollbacks.

Tomás Rivera: action items assigned: 
- ENG-SDK: roll hotfix to revert alias/mapping (ENG-SDK-1147). ETA: today (hotfix release 0.13.1).
- ENG-RUNTIME: add server-side validation for pinned model versions, return a clearer error when SDK returns a compacted dim. (ENG-RUNTIME-958) ETA: 48-72h.
- ENG-MON: add alert rule for embeddings p95 > 2s for requests with batch_size > 8.

Aisha Rahman: interim support message I will send the customer: 
- run curl pinned to model (example below) to confirm server returns 1536.
- temporarily set header `X-RWD-Disable-Embed-Downsample: 1` or downgrade to redwood-sdk==0.11.4.
- reduce batch_size to <= 8 to avoid p95 spikes.

Code snippet to bypass SDK (to include in support reply):
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY"
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  -H "X-RWD-Disable-Embed-Downsample: 1"
  -d '{"model":"rwd-embed-1@stable","input":["doc1","doc2"]}' | jq .
```

Docs Team: please add a short FAQ entry under docs/embeddings/troubleshooting: 
- explain dims per model (which are 1536 vs 768), 
- document SDK versions known to include compact/downsample behavior, 
- include the support runbook steps and header example above, 
- add a note about batching tradeoffs and recommended default batch_size=8.

eng-sdks-bot: ENG-SDK-1147 updated: hotfix branch created, tests added to assert model->dim invariant.

Tomás Rivera: support ticket SUP-6001 created linking BETA-1082; assigning to ENG-SDK and Docs for follow-up.

support-bot: created ticket SUP-6001 linking BETA-1082 -> SUP-6001

Aisha Rahman: customer replied: "curl worked, thanks. please tell us when the SDK patch is out and if we need to change any code." I told them hotfix ETA today and we'll follow up when 0.13.1 publishes. Also advised batch_size tip.

Priya Nair: I'll monitor ENG-SDK release and update SUP-6001. Once 0.13.1 is published we'll ask customer to upgrade and re-test; if problem persists escalate to runbook step 4.

Tomás Rivera: closing handoff here — support actions complete, ENG tickets created, Docs has the FAQ request. Will follow up with updates. :thumbsup:
